set.body:
Scope: tools/mvpa-inference (calibration_protocol/readiness, run_calibration, run_rank_pilot, rank_population, paired/*) plus the frozen records they read under docs/verification/umvpa-* and docs/scenarios/fixtures.

Context: eco-u4-core moved the MVPA core to ../mvpa4s (package mvpa4s, sbt projects coreJVM/coreJS). These qualification runners still name modules/mvpa paths, sbt project mvpaJVM, the ScalaFIM sbt-warm runner and source-lock path lists, and the paired protocol reads ScalaFIM verification records. Moving them requires porting the runner, re-deriving source locks, and carrying the records; changing a lock changes the provenance of recorded runs, so it must be an explicit, reviewed migration.

Acceptance: runners execute mvpa4s inference suites from the mvpa4s repository (or a declared ScalaFIM wrapper) with refreshed source locks; historical records stay readable and unaltered; python unit tests (test_calibration_protocol, test_calibration_readiness, paired/test_protocol) pass in the new home; ScalaFIM retains only the group oracle and spatial PyMVPA generator.
set.title: Port MVPA calibration and paired qualification harness to mvpa4s
